title: Complete 3D Projection Gizmo
description: Rebuild the ad-hoc corner orbit gizmo into a complete projection navigation control: face/corner/center cube emitting WorldProjectionSpec, plus a family switcher exposing every taxonomy kind, with fixed snap pipeline so all transitions land correctly.
summary: Fixed a regression from the projection-matrix-morph work: the ortho→persp and persp→persp-fov-change branches added to worldProjectionTransitionPose computed a new dolly-zoomed eye position, which broke the pre-existing invariant that mode-only projection switches never move the camera — causing the reported "camera resets and flies fore/back" whenever the user clicked into/out of Curvilinear. Removed both branches and their helper functions (worldProjectionMatchedPerspectiveDistance, worldProjectionFovCompensatedDistance); only the persp→ortho zoom-matching case remains (changes zoom, never position). The projection-matrix interpolation itself (perspective↔orthographic morph, oblique shear, curvilinear ramp) is untouched and still smooth. infinite/world/r3f tests 172/172 green, framework/renderer/react 252/252 green.
